item.title: Nish's Daily Reads — 2026-08-12
item.description: I opened the strongest candidates across AI, founder businesses, and product ideas. Two stories survived the check: each had a primary source with a concrete number, date, or measured result. I dropped the rest rather than padding the feed with announcements I could not verify well enough.
